name: Import a bundle
subtitle:
Drop the zip the other site produced and press Read bundle. Nothing is written until you press Import, and Preview will tell you exactly what would change before you do.

Nothing in the bundle is ever discarded, and nothing already here is replaced unless you turn overwriting on. Every resource is checked against your own permission for it — being allowed to run a migration is not, on its own, permission to rewrite the catalogue. Imported accounts arrive unable to sign in and with no role, and an imported plugin needs re-licensing on this domain.

A large bundle takes more than one press. If it stops part-way the site is partly populated — press Import again to carry on rather than starting over. Re-running is always safe: records are matched on their natural key, so nothing is written twice.

elements.label: Bundle file
elements.hint: The upload lands in the public folder for a few seconds before this screen moves it somewhere private. Press Read bundle straight away rather than leaving the page open.

elements.label: Leave out
elements.placeholder: Nothing — bring in everything the bundle carries
elements.hint: Everything in the bundle comes in unless you name it here. Anything you leave out has its data file never opened, so narrowing an import is cheaper, not just smaller.

elements.label: Passphrase, if the bundle carries credentials
elements.hint: Read bundle will tell you whether this one has any. Credentials are applied last, so a wrong passphrase costs nothing that already imported — they are skipped, you are told, and this site's existing keys are left exactly as they were.

confirm.title: Overwrite this site's own records?
confirm.text: Where a record in the bundle has the same identity as one already here, the version on THIS site will be replaced by the one in the bundle. That is not reversible — only pages keep a snapshot you can go back to. Leave this off and nothing here is touched: a clashing record is added alongside under a free name, so no data is lost from either site.

elements.label: Overwrite my records when they clash
elements.hint: Off, a record whose identity is already taken here — the same SKU, slug or discount code — is added alongside under a free name, and an invoice or order is renumbered with this site's next number in sequence rather than a suffix (the customer's copy still shows the old number, which is kept on the imported record). On, this site's version is replaced, which also requires permission to update each resource.

elements.label: What would change
elements.placeholder: Press Preview to see what this bundle would do.
